g.text: Maximum nonpermitted adult bulk versus reproductive RNA · HPA native nTPM
Color uses the complete evidence cascade, not these two RNA values alone. TBXT can enter through embryonic expression.
CTAG1A/B and XAGE1A/B are summed within matched source contexts before filtering; named genes have no automatic admission.
